CustomField.description: Org-wide / verified email address used by Email-to-Case routing. Stamped onto the draft reply EmailMessage as BOTH FromAddress and ValidatedFromAddress. ValidatedFromAddress MUST match a verified Organization-Wide Email Address (or a verified address) or the eventual agent send fails. Change here to repoint the reply sender without a code deploy. Blank = no sender stamped (agent picks one in the composer).
CustomField.label: Reply From Address
